dishes.name: Balık ekmek
dishes.desc: Grilled mackerel in a bread roll with onion and salad, sold from boats and stalls at the Galata Bridge and along the Bosphorus.

dishes.name: Börek
dishes.desc: Layered or rolled pastry filled with white cheese, spinach or mince, sold in bakeries and börekçis throughout the city.

dishes.name: Kumpir
dishes.desc: Large baked potato mashed with butter and cheese, then loaded with toppings. A street food closely tied to Ortaköy on the Bosphorus.

dishes.name: Midye dolma
dishes.desc: Mussels stuffed with spiced rice, served cold with lemon from street stalls, especially around Beyoğlu and Kadıköy.

dishes.name: Kokoreç
dishes.desc: Seasoned lamb offal wrapped around a skewer, grilled and chopped into a bread roll. A late-night street food of Beyoğlu and Kadıköy.

dishes.name: Baklava
dishes.desc: Layers of thin pastry with pistachio or walnut and syrup, sold in the historic sweet shops of the old city.

dishes.name: Turkish delight
dishes.desc: Soft gel sweets of starch and sugar with rose, pistachio or hazelnut, sold by weight in the old shops around the Spice Bazaar.
